roles/cloudcontrolspartner.accessApprova.title: Cloud Controls Partner Access Approval Service Agent
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.accessApprova.desc: Gives the Partner Console service account access to read Access Approval Requests for workloads associated with a partner.

roles/cloudcontrolspartner.admin.title: Cloud Controls Partner Admin
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.admin.desc: Full access to Cloud Controls Partner resources.

roles/cloudcontrolspartner.editor.title: Cloud Controls Partner Editor
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.editor.desc: Editor access to Cloud Controls Partner resources.

roles/cloudcontrolspartner.ekmServiceAge.title: Cloud Controls Partner EKM Service Agent
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.ekmServiceAge.desc: Gives Cloud Controls Partner service agent permission to list EKM connections, get EKM connection status, and provide EKM diagnostic information.

roles/cloudcontrolspartner.inspectabilit.title: Cloud Controls Partner Inspectability Reader
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.inspectabilit.desc: Readonly access to Cloud Controls Partner inspectability resources.

roles/cloudcontrolspartner.monitoringRea.title: Cloud Controls Partner Monitoring Reader
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.monitoringRea.desc: Read-only access to Cloud Controls Partner monitoring resources.

roles/cloudcontrolspartner.monitoringSer.title: Cloud Controls Partner Monitoring Service Agent
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.monitoringSer.desc: Gives Cloud Controls Partner monitoring service agent permission to view and list Assured Workload violations. The role is assigned to enable partner monitoring capability.

roles/cloudcontrolspartner.reader.title: Cloud Controls Partner Reader
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.reader.desc: Read-only access to Cloud Controls Partner resources.

roles/cloudcontrolspartner.supportCaseSe.title: Cloud Controls Partner Support Case Service Agent
roles/cloudcontrolspartner.supportCaseSe.desc: Gives the Partner Console service account access to support cases for workloads associated with a partner.
